name: Jimmy Ozaeta
office: City of South Gate, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jimmy Ozaeta was appointed to the South Gate Planning Commission in 2023. He is the chair of the commission. He served as Chief Advance Officer at UMMA Community Clinic. He served 15 years with YMCAs across California, rising to CEO of a local YMCA association.

sentences.text: Jimmy Ozaeta was appointed to the South Gate Planning Commission in 2023.
He is the chair of the commission.
He served as Chief Advance Officer at UMMA Community Clinic.
He served 15 years with YMCAs across California, rising to CEO of a local YMCA association.

items.text: His campaign says he opposes the Utility Users Tax, calling it an unnecessary tax increase. He is running with a slate that advocates against the tax and for term limits. He has called for a full infrastructure audit and pledged to end wasteful spending. He has also spoken in public comment about a Public Records Act request regarding utility users tax survey results.
